school.tagged_body:
Wednesday, April 16
Today was a {{v:special}} day.
My family got a {{v:puppy}}!
He is a small white dog. He has brown {{v:ears}}.
His name is Cotton. {{g:He looks soft like cotton|look + 형용사: ~하게 보이다 / like + 명사: ~처럼}}.
In the morning, Dad and I went to the {{v:pet shop}}.
We bought a bed, a {{v:bowl}}, and a red ball.
At home, Cotton was {{v:afraid}}.
He {{g:hid|hide의 과거형: 숨었다 (불규칙 과거)}} under the sofa for thirty minutes.
Then I {{v:rolled}} the red ball to him.
He came out and played with me!
At night, Cotton slept in his new bed.
His bed was next to my room.
I was very happy.
{{t:Tomorrow, I will walk him in the park after school}}.

questions.q: What day did the writer write this diary?
questions.explanation: 일기 맨 위에 'Wednesday, April 16'이라고 쓰여 있다.

questions.q: What did the writer's family get?
questions.explanation: 'My family got a puppy!'와 일치한다.

questions.explanation: 'He has brown ears.'와 일치한다. 몸은 흰색이다.

questions.q: Why is the puppy's name Cotton?
questions.explanation: 'His name is Cotton. He looks soft like cotton.'에서 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Who went to the pet shop?
questions.explanation: 'Dad and I went to the pet shop.'과 일치한다. I는 글쓴이이다.

choices: A bed, a sofa, and a ball
A bowl, a cake, and a hat
A bed, a bowl, and a red ball
A red ball and a book
A dog house and a bowl
questions.answer: A bed, a bowl, and a red ball
questions.explanation: 'We bought a bed, a bowl, and a red ball.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: 다음 중 'afraid'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: afraid는 '무서워하는, 겁먹은'이라는 뜻이다. 그래서 코튼이 소파 밑에 숨었다.

questions.q: Where did Cotton hide?
questions.explanation: 'He hid under the sofa for thirty minutes.'와 일치한다.

questions.q: How long did Cotton hide?
questions.explanation: 'for thirty minutes'와 일치한다.

questions.q: What did the writer roll to Cotton?
questions.explanation: 'Then I rolled the red ball to him.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: What will the writer do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 'Tomorrow, I will walk him in the park after school.'과 일치한다.

questions.q: My family got a ____!
questions.explanation: 'My family got a puppy!'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: He hid under the ____ for thirty minutes.
questions.explanation: 'He hid under the sofa for thirty minutes.'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Then I ____ the red ball to him.
questions.explanation: 'Then I rolled the red ball to him.'에서 확인할 수 있다. roll은 '굴리다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: At night, Cotton slept in his new ____.
questions.explanation: 'At night, Cotton slept in his new bed.'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Tomorrow, I will ____ him in the park after school.
questions.explanation: 'Tomorrow, I will walk him in the park after school.'에서 확인할 수 있다. walk a dog은 '개를 산책시키다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Cotton is a big black dog.
questions.explanation: 'He is a small white dog.'이라고 했으므로 사실이 아니다.

questions.q: Cotton came out and played with the writer.
questions.explanation: 'He came out and played with me!'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Cotton's bed was next to the writer's room.
questions.explanation: 'His bed was next to my room.'과 일치한다.

advanced.tagged_body:
Wednesday, April 16
Today was a really special day {{g:because my family finally got a puppy|because + 문장: ~ 때문에}}! He is a small white dog with soft brown ears. We {{g:decided to name|decide to + 동사원형: ~하기로 결정하다}} him Cotton because his {{v:fur}} {{g:looks as soft as cotton|as + 형용사 + as: ~만큼 …한 (원급 비교)}}.
In the morning, Dad and I went to the pet shop {{g:to buy some things for Cotton|to부정사의 부사적 용법(목적): ~하기 위해}}. We bought a bed, a food bowl, and a {{v:bright}} red ball. When we got home, Cotton was scared at first. He hid under the sofa and didn't come out for thirty minutes. Then I slowly rolled the red ball {{v:toward}} him. {{v:Finally}}, he came out and started playing with me!
At night, Cotton {{v:fell asleep}} in his new bed next to my room. {{g:I was so excited that I couldn't stop smiling|so + 형용사 + that ...: 너무 ~해서 …하다}}. {{t:Tomorrow, I am going to take him for a walk in the park after school}}.

prestudy.tagged_body:
Wednesday, April 16
Today was {{g:one of the most special days|one of the + 최상급 + 복수명사: 가장 ~한 것들 중 하나}} of my life, because my family finally {{v:adopted}} a puppy! He is a tiny white dog with {{v:floppy}} brown ears. We decided to name him Cotton, {{g:since his fluffy fur looks as soft as a ball of cotton|since: ~ 때문에 (이유의 접속사) / as ~ as 원급 비교}}.
Early in the morning, Dad and I visited a pet shop to prepare {{g:everything Cotton would need|목적격 관계대명사 생략 (everything (that) Cotton would need)}}. We picked out a {{v:cozy}} bed, a food bowl, and a bright red ball. When we brought him home, however, Cotton was {{g:too frightened to explore|too + 형용사 + to부정사: 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다}} his new {{v:surroundings}}. He hid under the sofa and {{v:refused}} to come out for thirty whole minutes. {{g:Hoping to make him feel comfortable|분사구문: ~하기를 바라면서 / make + 목적어 + 동사원형}}, I gently rolled the red ball toward him. {{g:To my delight|to one's delight: ~가 기쁘게도}}, he {{v:crept}} out slowly and began playing with me!
That night, Cotton fell fast asleep in his new bed, {{g:which we had placed right next to my room|계속적 용법 관계대명사 which + 과거완료 had placed}}. I was so excited that I could {{v:hardly}} fall asleep myself. {{t:Tomorrow, after school, I am planning to take him for his very first walk in the park}}.

questions.q: What does 'adopted' mean in 'my family finally adopted a puppy'?
choices: Took a puppy into the family
Lost a puppy in the park
Drew a picture of a puppy
Visited a puppy at a friend's house
questions.answer: Took a puppy into the family
questions.explanation: adopt는 '입양하다', 즉 가족으로 받아들인다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which word in the passage describes Cotton's fur?
questions.explanation: 'his fluffy fur'라고 했다. floppy는 귀, cozy는 침대, bright는 공을 꾸미는 말이다.

questions.q: Choose the word that best fits the blank: We decided to name him Cotton, ____ his fluffy fur looks as soft as a ball of cotton.
questions.explanation: 뒤 문장이 이름을 지은 이유이므로 '~ 때문에'라는 뜻의 since가 알맞다.

questions.q: What does 'Cotton was too frightened to explore his new surroundings' mean?
choices: Cotton was so scared that he couldn't look around his new home.
Cotton was excited to look around his new home.
Cotton explored the house very quickly.
Cotton was too tired to eat.
Cotton wanted to go back to the pet shop.
questions.answer: Cotton was so scared that he couldn't look around his new home.
questions.explanation: 'too + 형용사 + to부정사'는 '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'라는 뜻이다. 너무 겁이 나서 새 환경을 둘러보지 못했다.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'refused' in the passage?
questions.explanation: refuse는 '거부하다, ~하려 하지 않다'라는 뜻이다. 코튼은 30분 동안 나오려 하지 않았다.

questions.q: Why did the writer roll the ball gently toward Cotton?
choices: To show Dad a new game
To make Cotton go to sleep
questions.explanation: 'Hoping to make him feel comfortable, I gently rolled the red ball toward him.'에서 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Choose the word that best fits the blank: ____ to make him feel comfortable, I gently rolled the red ball toward him.
questions.explanation: 주어(I)가 '바라는' 능동의 관계이므로 현재분사로 시작하는 분사구문 'Hoping ~'이 알맞다.

questions.q: What does 'To my delight' tell us about the writer?
choices: The writer was surprised and scared.
The writer was very happy about what happened.
The writer was bored with the game.
The writer was worried about Dad.
questions.answer: The writer was very happy about what happened.
questions.explanation: to my delight는 '기쁘게도'라는 뜻이다. 코튼이 나와서 놀기 시작해서 글쓴이가 기뻤다.

questions.q: Where had the family placed Cotton's bed?
choices: Right next to the writer's room
questions.answer: Right next to the writer's room
questions.explanation: 'his new bed, which we had placed right next to my room'과 일치한다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the diary?
choices: Dad and the writer visited a pet shop in the morning.
Cotton hid under the sofa for thirty minutes.
Cotton went for a walk in the park on Wednesday.
The writer could hardly fall asleep that night.
questions.answer: Cotton went for a walk in the park on Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 공원 산책은 내일(목요일) 학교가 끝난 뒤에 할 계획이며, 코튼의 '첫 산책'이 될 것이다.

questions.q: What is the diary mainly about?
choices: How to choose a pet shop
Why puppies are better than cats
The writer's first day with a new puppy
How to make a dog bed
questions.answer: The writer's first day with a new puppy
questions.explanation: 강아지를 입양한 첫날 있었던 일(가게, 숨기, 공놀이, 잠들기)을 적은 일기이다.

questions.q: He is a tiny white dog with ____ brown ears.
questions.explanation: 'a tiny white dog with floppy brown ears'에서 확인할 수 있다. floppy는 '축 늘어진'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: We picked out a ____ bed, a food bowl, and a bright red ball.
questions.explanation: 'a cozy bed'에서 확인할 수 있다. cozy는 '아늑한'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Cotton was too frightened to explore his new ____.
questions.explanation: 'to explore his new surroundings'에서 확인할 수 있다. surroundings는 '주변 환경'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: To my delight, he ____ out slowly and began playing with me!
questions.explanation: 'he crept out slowly'에서 확인할 수 있다. crept는 creep(살금살금 기다)의 과거형이다.

questions.q: I was so excited that I could ____ fall asleep myself.
questions.explanation: 'I could hardly fall asleep myself'에서 확인할 수 있다. hardly는 '거의 ~ 않다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Cotton explored his new home as soon as he arrived.
questions.explanation: 'Cotton was too frightened to explore his new surroundings'라고 했으므로 사실이 아니다.

questions.q: The writer had trouble falling asleep that night.
questions.explanation: 'I could hardly fall asleep myself'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Cotton has already been for a walk in the park.
questions.explanation: 내일 'his very first walk(첫 산책)'를 할 계획이므로 아직 산책한 적이 없다.

items: To my delight, he crept out slowly and began playing with me!
We picked out a cozy bed, a food bowl, and a bright red ball.
He hid under the sofa and refused to come out for thirty whole minutes.
Hoping to make him feel comfortable, I gently rolled the red ball toward him.
answer: We picked out a cozy bed, a food bowl, and a bright red ball.
He hid under the sofa and refused to come out for thirty whole minutes.
Hoping to make him feel comfortable, I gently rolled the red ball toward him.
To my delight, he crept out slowly and began playing with me!

essays.q: Explain in English why Cotton hid under the sofa.
essays.sampleAnswer: He hid because he was too frightened in his new home.
essays.rubric: 새 집(환경)이 낯설어서 무서웠다는 이유를 영어로 쓰면 만점

essays.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'too ~ to': Cotton was so frightened that he couldn't explore his new surroundings.
essays.sampleAnswer: Cotton was too frightened to explore his new surroundings.
essays.rubric: too frightened to explore 구조를 바르게 쓰고 의미가 같으면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'To my delight, he crept out slowly and began playing with me!'의 의미를 쓰고, 글쓴이가 기뻤던 이유를 설명하시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 기쁘게도 코튼이 천천히 기어 나와 나와 놀기 시작했다는 뜻이다. 겁이 나서 30분이나 숨어 있던 코튼이 드디어 마음을 열고 함께 놀아 주었기 때문에 기뻤다.
essays.rubric: 문장을 바르게 해석 + 숨어 있던 코튼이 나와서 함께 놀았다는 이유를 쓰면 만점, 한 가지만 쓰면 부분 점수

essays.q: Describe in English how Cotton's feelings changed during the day.
essays.sampleAnswer: At first, Cotton was frightened and hid under the sofa, but later he felt comfortable and played with the writer.
essays.rubric: 처음(무서워함)과 나중(편안해져 놂)을 비교해서 영어로 쓰면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'I could hardly fall asleep myself.'는 무슨 뜻이며, 글쓴이가 왜 그랬을까요?
essays.sampleAnswer: 나도 거의 잠을 잘 수 없었다는 뜻이다. 강아지가 생겨서 너무 신이 났고, 내일 코튼과 첫 산책을 할 생각에 설렜기 때문이다.
essays.rubric: hardly(거의 ~ 않다)를 살려 바르게 해석 + 너무 신이 났다는 이유를 쓰면 만점
